bodyHTML:
Implemented both course adaptations.

Key considerations:

  • Python is now clearly grouped into Beginning, Intermediate, and Advanced.
  • Every class is explicitly labeled in ascending order: “Beginning 1,” “Intermediate 1,” “Advanced 1,” etc.
  • The grouped, collapsible layout remains compact on small screens.
  • Python lesson headers now include Contents, Previous, Next, Library, Save, and Download.
  • Previous/Next navigation continues correctly across level boundaries.
  • Chinese Medicine chapters now include Previous/Next chapter navigation.
  • Its complete annotation toolbar remains available and scrolls horizontally on narrow screens.
  • Bottom toolbars are enabled for both courses, including offline-book, update, installation, reading, and editing controls.
  • Python now has a 33-class offline manifest.
  • English pages automatically receive English toolbar labels.

I rebuilt all generated pages and validated all 33 Python class paths and both generators successfully.
